# FDG3047

> CONSIDER indicating constraints placed on a type parameter in the name of the parameter.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.5.1 Names of Generic Type Parameters.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

For example, a parameter constrained to `ISession` might be called `TSession`.
